'''Kelbeross''' (ケルベロス; keruberosu) is a demonic dog creature who protects Jaquio as the boss of Act 4 in [[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|Ninja Gaiden]], and returns as the boss of Act 6 in [[Ninja Gaiden II: The Dark Sword of Chaos]]. Before it was a demon, it started off as a loyal pet of [[Jaquio]] that lived life as a normal dog. In an exchange for power, Jaquio killed his dog and offered it as a pledge sacrifice to evil spirits. Being brought back to life, the Kelbeross was given a powerful demonic form, as well as a twin. Despite this horrific act, the Kelbeross continues to live a life of unyielding loyalty and protection to its master.

Using its newfound power, Kelbeross can duplicate itself to confuse the intruders and spits corrosive balls of saliva as projectiles.  It is almost certainly named after the Cerberus, the mythological three headed dog that guarded the gates of Hades (hell) in greek mythology.

== [[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|Ninja Gaiden]] ==
Kelbeross is the boss of Act 4, and Ryu encounters it and its twin in the [[Space of Kelbeross]]. The two dogs here move around the area with short hops of varying lengths, moving back and forth along the room and interacting with the platforms on each side. Each dog is capable of shooting pink projectiles forward from their mouths as they jump, but they won't hurt Ryu so long as he stays on the ground. 

With both dogs have their own HP, only one of these dogs is the real one. The fake one can be damaged and defeated, but this won't end the fight nor will it subtract from the real one's HP. The real Kelbeross is always the one that spawns on the left side of the room, closest to Ryu's starting position. All of their attacks do 3 damage. Kelbeross's biggest weakness is the [[Jump & Slash Technique]]: if Ryu jumps in place from where he spawns in and attacks as soon as the fight begins, it's guaranteed to one-shot Kelbeross.

There is a very rare glitch where killing the fake one with a sub-weapon like the Windmill Star may trigger an event that duplicates multiple fake Kelberosses, up to 3 in addition to the real one.

== Ninja Gaiden II: The Dark Sword of Chaos ==
Kelbeross is the boss of Act VI, and Ryu encounters it and its twin in the entrance to a castle in the Realm of Chaos. Their appearance has been slightly altered from the previous game, with both dogs now sporting horns and vestigial bat-like wings. Their behavior is similar to the previous game, with both dogs hopping around the room, interacting with the platforms and bouncing off whenever they collide with a wall, and shooting pink projectiles. Unlike the previous game, their jumps are of a consistent length and height, and they always fire one projectile at the start of each of their jumps.

While both dogs are capable of damaging Ryu, only one of these dogs is real. The fake cannot be damaged in any way, and attacking it will not affect the real one's HP. Unlike the previous game, which Kelbeross is real and which one is fake is randomized at the start of the battle. Their projectiles do 1 damage to Ryu, while making contact with either dog deals 2 damage. 

There exist two major glitches that the player can exploit to make this fight easier. If Ryu climbs up the right-side wall, it's possible to clip into it by wall-jumping up and over the top edge. From this position, Ryu's [[Dragon Sword]] is long enough to attack through the safety of the wall, where neither dog can reach him or hit him with their projectiles, allowing the player to simply mash the attack button and wait for the real dog to collide with the blade enough times. Alternatively, when the fake dog is directly next to the door on the left side of the room, hitting it with the Windmill Star sub-weapon can cause it to bounce out the door and offscreen, de-spawning the fake for the rest of the battle. 

After the battle, Ryu will note that he has fought Kelbeross before, and express confusion as to how it is present in the Realm of Chaos.
